note: One drawn particle: where it sits, what it hangs off, and how far into its run it is.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The unit the effect is aimed at, or zero.

fields.name: effect
fields.note: The name this particle answers to, so later messages can name it.

fields.name: caster
fields.note: The unit that made it, or zero.

fields.name: boundTo
fields.note: The unit it hangs off, or zero.

fields.name: unknown1
fields.note: Purpose undetermined. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where the effect sits, along one ground axis. Carried in the units a path uses rather than in world units.

fields.name: atY
fields.note: Where it sits, in height. Carried in world units.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where it sits, along the other ground axis. It shares the reading of the first.

fields.name: towardX
fields.note: Where the effect is aimed, along one ground axis, read as the first pair above.

fields.name: towardY
fields.note: Where it is aimed, in height.

fields.name: towardZ
fields.note: Where it is aimed, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: ownerX
fields.note: Where the unit that made it stood, along one ground axis, read as the first pair above.

fields.name: ownerY
fields.note: Where that unit stood, in height.

fields.name: ownerZ
fields.note: Where that unit stood, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: facingX
fields.note: Which way the effect faces, along one ground axis.

fields.name: facingY
fields.note: Which way the effect faces, in height.

fields.name: facingZ
fields.note: Which way the effect faces, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: runningFor
fields.note: How far into its run it already is, in seconds.

fields.name: scale
fields.note: What its drawn size is scaled by.
